description.value: Kanadell Japanese Bakery is a small East Vancouver storefront founded by Japanese-born baker Keiko Nakanishi, specializing in authentic Japanese breads and pastries such as melon pan, curry pan, and elaborately crafted whole cakes. The bakery grew from an online operation and farmers-market vendor into a neighbourhood shop with indoor café seating, and was featured on Food Network Canada's 'Project Bakeover.' It also participates in local farmers markets and offers pre-ordering, catering, and UberEats delivery.
